packet.title: Android build and the two fallbacks (implementation, here)

body.p: (, ): the fallbacks, the presets, tools/build-android.sh and tools/fetch-binding-toolchains.sh are committed. All four ABIs build with -Werror at android-24, and LOAD is 0x4000 on arm64-v8a and x86_64. Device runs are the owner's (no KVM here). Resume from bindings/kotlin/DESIGN.md. After , and after any running packet commits its changes to src/processor.c (it was being edited when this plan was written). Owns:

item.p: src/allocator.c (sxml_heap_allocate) and src/processor.c (the system clock), one __ANDROID_API__ branch each;

CMakePresets.json (new presets android-arm64-v8a, android-armeabi-v7a, android-x86_64 and android-x86, toolchain $env{ANDROID_NDK_HOME}/build/cmake/android.toolchain.cmake, ANDROID_PLATFORM android-24, MinSizeRel);
new tools/build-android.sh (all four ABIs, a size report);
new tools/fetch-binding-toolchains.sh (ndk, android-sdk, kotlin, swift into a named directory, with pinned versions and SHA-256 sums);
all four ABIs build with -Werror at android-24, the library and the unit tests (built, not run);
readelf shows 16 KB LOAD alignment on arm64-v8a and x86_64;
the debug preset still passes the allocator and clock tests.
